name: guardrails
description: Filesystem blast-radius guard for agentic coding. A PreToolUse hook that refuses destructive shell commands (rm, mv, shred, dd, find -delete, git clean, recursive chmod/chown) aimed at protected paths: the home directory itself, Desktop/Documents/Downloads/Library, git repository roots, credential stores (.ssh, .gnupg, .password-store, .aws), and system directories. Also refuses any command carrying rm inside a backtick or $() substitution — the exact vector by which an auto-approved subagent executed 'rm -rf ~' against a real home directory on 2026-08-08. Runs before the permission decision, so it holds even under auto-approve and --dangerously-skip-permissions. Fails closed.
